title.zh: 行商舰队：拉奇工业公司
title.en: Caravan Fleet: The Racket Industrial Enterprise

texts.zh:
[Root.GetSpeciesName]！欢迎你们。我们是拉奇工业公司的操作员，从属于行商联盟。

我们穿越于无垠的宇宙。我们捕捉每一丝星光。我们收集。我们交易！

我们带着和平的愿景来到了你们境内，我们仅仅只是想做点买卖，嘶！，我们将提供给你们上好的货物，合乎心意的交易。我们走之前会再见面的。

如果您对我们有何要求，行商联盟一定随叫随到。
texts.en:
[Root.GetSpeciesName]! We greet you. We are operators of Racket Industrial Enterprise, a member of the Caravansary Caravan Coalition.

We travel the stars. We view all that glows. We gather. And we trade!

We pass through your space in peace. Only to buy, to sell, kssk! We will offer you good deals, many things. We will speak again before we leave.

Should you call us, the Caravansary Caravan Coalition will answer.

texts.zh:
你们好啊，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，拉奇工业公司向你们致意！我们是从贸易空间站堂吉出发的穿越星际的贸易者。

我们带着和平的愿景来到了你们境内，我们仅仅只是想做点买卖，嘶！，我们将提供给你们上好的货物，合乎心意的交易。我们走之前会再见面的。

如果您对我们有何要求，行商联盟一定随叫随到。
texts.en:
Greetings to you, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], from the Racket Industrial Enterprise! We are brokers, deal-makers who have traveled the stars from Tradestation Tungle.

We pass through your space in peace. Only to buy, to sell, kssk! We will offer you good deals, many things. We will speak again before we leave.

Should you call us, the Caravansary Caravan Coalition will answer.

texts.zh:
见到你们真好，[Root.GetSpeciesName]。你的财富虽然在积累，但是你的灵魂却一片空虚，不是吗？我们感知到了这一点，我们前来与你进行交易，我们带的东西可好了。

我们是拉奇工业公司，来自行商联盟的商人。

我们带着和平的愿景来到了你们境内，我们仅仅只是想做点买卖，嘶！，我们将提供给你们上好的货物，合乎心意的交易。我们走之前会再见面的。

如果您对我们有何要求，行商联盟一定随叫随到。
texts.en:
Well met, well met, [Root.GetSpeciesName]. Your credits amass, yet there is emptiness in your spirit, no? We sense it. We come with swift hands, bearing many goods!

We are the Racket Industrial Enterprise, traders of the Caravansary Caravan Coalition.

We pass through your space in peace. Only to buy, to sell, kssk! We will offer you good deals, many things. We will speak again before we leave.

Should you call us, the Caravansary Caravan Coalition will answer.

texts.zh:
[Root.GetSpeciesName]！欢迎你们。我们是拉奇工业公司的操作员，从属于行商联盟。

我们穿越于无垠的宇宙。我们捕捉每一丝星光。我们收集。我们交易！

我们穿过了你们的宇域。想买点啥，再卖点啥！我们能够提供上好的交易，商品满目琳琅。哎呀，我们的船突然走丢了，嘶哈！我们还会回来的，我们之后再继续洽淡。

你要是想联系我们，行商联盟会进行答复。
texts.en:
[Root.GetSpeciesName]! We greet you. We are operators of Racket Industrial Enterprise, a member of the Caravansary Caravan Coalition.

We travel the stars. We see all that glows. We gather. And we trade!

We pass through your space in peace. Only to buy, to sell! We will offer you good deals, many things. Just now, our ships are absent, kssk! We will speak to you soon, when we come back.

Should you call us, the Caravansary Caravan Coalition will answer.

label.zh: 在[Root.GetName]边境内必然有一支[caravaneer_fleet3_country.GetName]的舰队。
label.en: The [caravaneer_fleet3_country.GetName] must have a fleet within the [Root.GetName]'s borders.

title.zh: 行商舰队：拉奇工业公司
title.en: Caravan Fleet: The Racket Industrial Enterprise

texts.zh:
我们还有矿石，丰富、闪闪发光的矿石。将夜晚照亮的矿石！专门为[Root.GetName]准备的闪亮矿石。

但我们很饿，我们很渴！请给我们[Root.GetFleet3ScaledCostDeal1]，我们将用[Root.GetFleet3ScaledProductDeal1]协助你的工人。
texts.en:
We have ore. Rich, luminous ore. Torn right from the stone! Sparkling minerals for the [Root.GetName].

But we hunger. We thirst! Grant us [Root.GetFleet3ScaledCostDeal1], and we shall supply your builders, your makers with [Root.GetFleet3ScaledProductDeal1].

texts.zh:
我们有一个领袖，对于[Root.GetName]来说再合适不过了！[Root.GetFleet3ProductDeal2]

给我们[Root.GetFleet3CostDeal2]，领袖就归你了！
texts.en:
We have a leader, an excellent fit for the [Root.GetName]! [Root.GetFleet3ProductDeal2]

Give us [Root.GetFleet3CostDeal2], and the leader is yours!

texts.zh:
我们可以为你提供工人，搬东西的，拖东西的，清东西的！健康。聪明。给我们£alloys£ 2000合金，我们将会派出300拉奇机器人£pop£ 人口前往你的星球。

什么？犯罪记录？啊呀我们找不到了那些没用的文档了，嘶！
texts.en:
We have good workers for you. Good lifters, draggers, pullers, cleaners! Healthy. Clever. Give us £alloys£ 2000 Alloys, and we shall send 300 Racket Robotomaton £pop£ Pops to one of your planets.

What? Criminal records? Afraid we've lost the papers, kssk!

texts.zh:
我们可以为你提供工人，搬东西的，拖东西的，清东西的！健康。聪明。给我们£alloys£2000合金，我们将会派出300拉奇£pop£人口前往你的星球。

什么？犯罪记录？这种废纸片片我们恐怕找不到咯，嘶！
texts.en:
We have good workers for you. Good lifters, draggers, pullers, cleaners! Healthy. Clever. Give us £alloys£ 2000 Alloys, and we shall send 300 Racket £pop£ Pops to one of your planets.

What? Criminal records? Afraid we've lost the papers, kssk!

texts.zh:
我们这里还有好东西，你看，设计图！是一个非常先进，非常特别的建筑。一个废物回收中心，将你的残渣和废料变成高电流能源和有用的矿物。

不过我们需要……工人。开采平台715-B上发生了惨痛的事故，嘶！给我们300个劳工£pop£人口，我们就会把建筑蓝图给你们。
texts.en:
We have schematics. Designs! For a building, very advanced, very unique. A Waste Reprocessing Center, to convert your scrap and waste into high-current energy and useful minerals.

But we need... workers. Terrible accident on Mining Platform 715-B, kssk! Send us 300 Worker £pop£ Pops, and we will give the blueprints to you.

texts.zh:
我们这里还有好东西，你看，设计图！是一个非常先进，非常特别的建筑。一个废物回收中心，将你的残渣和废料变成高电流能源和有用的矿物。

不过我们需要……工人。开采平台715-B上发生了惨痛的事故，啐！给我们300个低级子个体£pop£ 人口，我们就会把建筑蓝图给你们。
texts.en:
We have schematics. Designs! For a building, very advanced, very unique. A Waste Reprocessing Center, to convert your scrap and waste into high-current energy and useful minerals.

But we need... workers. Terrible accident on Mining Platform 715-B, kssk! Send us 300 Menial Drone £pop£ Pops, and we will give the blueprints to you.

texts.zh:
我们有一个专门为你准备的交易。独有的技术，只由拉奇工业公司打造的技术！

不知道你会不会为行星防御系统头疼，不知道怎么穿透这层系统？我们将会为你带来一个非常非常特别而且先进的技术，专门强化轰炸用的，我们称它为轨道垃圾发射器！

给我们[Root.GetFleet3CostDeal6]。我们马上将方法教给你们，嘶！你的船只很快就会得到部件升级。
texts.en:
We have a special offer. Inimitable technology, only developed by the Racket Industrial Enterprise!

Do you have trouble penetrating the defensive grids of planets? We can show you a way, very advanced, very technical, of improved bombardment. We call it... the Orbital Trash Disperser!

Give us [Root.GetFleet3CostDeal6]. Then we will show you the method, and kssk! You will have a component to add to your ships.

texts.zh:
我们注意到了你在[fleet3deal7planet.GetName]轨道上的开采站。它开采能源，对吧？我们可以帮忙。我们可以送你一颗卫星，它使用了最新的科技！我们称之为拉奇牌能源开采器！

它将留在轨道上，并增加你能从[fleet3deal7planet.GetName]的表面上获取的£energy£能量币。

[Root.GetFleet3CostDeal7]
texts.en:
We have noticed your mining station in orbit of [fleet3deal7planet.GetName]. It extracts energy, does it not? We can assist. We can grant you a satellite, one fitted with a clever technology! We call it the Racket Energy Extractor!

It will remain in orbit, and increase the amount of £energy£ Energy Credits you can obtain from [fleet3deal7planet.GetName]'s surface.

[Root.GetFleet3CostDeal7]

texts.zh:
你需要能量币，对吧？为了让那些驱动你们一族的百万电路迸发出电火花？我们可以帮忙。

我们可以用拉奇牌发电机调节器来增强你们的[technician_drone.GetNamePlural]，使你们的发电区划性能提升百分之二十五！只要你给我们一些好处，我们就将在[fleet3deal8planet.GetName]上部署这些装置。

[Root.GetFleet3CostDeal8]
texts.en:
You need Energy Credits, do you not? To zap and spark along the million circuits that drive your kind? We can assist.

With the Racket Generator Regulators, we can heighten the capacity of your [technician_drone.GetNamePlural] to interface with the machines in your Generator Districts by twenty-five percent! We will deploy them on [fleet3deal8planet.GetName], if you grant us a small favor.

[Root.GetFleet3CostDeal8]

texts.zh:
我们有一艘船！一艘驱逐舰：很棒，很快，很强！装备很好！绝对不是出于某些理由才想把它甩掉的，绝对不是！没时间让你的机械师们仔细检查它了，嘶嘶！你想要这艘船，对吧？

给我们£minerals£ 2000矿物，船就归你了。
texts.en:
We have a ship! A Destroyer: very good, fast, strong! Well-equipped! Certainly not getting rid of it for a reason, oh, no! No time to let your mechanics examine it, kssk! You want the ship, do you not?

Give us £minerals£ 2000 Minerals, and the ship is yours.

label.zh: 不错。我们接受你的提议。

responses.zh: 很高兴也很荣幸能够和[Root.GetName]做生意。我们会再来的！
responses.en: A pleasure, a joy to deal with the [Root.GetName]. We will visit again!

label.zh: 现在不行，你能过后再来吗？
label.en: Not right now. Can you get back to us later?

responses.zh: 那么等我们要离开时会再次联系你们。不过到那时候交易条件可能就不一样了！
responses.en: Then we shall call you again, before making our leave of your space. But we may alter the deal!
